crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/desoto.intro: Crawl space sewage cleanup in DeSoto can be needed when a repaired drain runs above contaminated insulation that must be addressed before the underside is closed again. We will separate insulation removal from treatment of the retained surfaces it conceals.

sections.title: Crawl space sewage cleanup in DeSoto around affected insulation
sections.text: We will review reachable wastewater and collect it where needed before material handling proceeds. The insulation condition and accessible release area will guide the removal proposal. The pipe repair location provides a reference, but it will not automatically limit evaluation to the small area directly beneath the connection.

sections.title: Treat the assembly revealed by removal
sections.text: Authorized insulation disposal can expose floor components requiring their own cleanup. We will remove remaining soil and residue from accessible retained surfaces using an appropriate method, then perform any disinfection included in the treatment plan. A new insulation layer will not stand in for cleaning the surfaces above it.

sections.title: Provide a practical replacement boundary
sections.text: Moisture findings will guide the remaining drying work. We will identify sections treated and areas still requiring access or another decision before replacement is scheduled. Plumbing service and the installation of new components will keep separate completion responsibilities.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/desoto.estimate: The quote will distinguish wastewater collection, insulation handling, retained-surface treatment and drying. Share the replacement proposal so cleanup boundaries and installation quantities can be understood without assuming they must be identical.
